description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruwita D/S Division, Ratnapura - Cad. Map No. 620274 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
